releaseNotes: v247: Production invoice workflow aligned with the tested v247 behavior. New invoices start as Draft; Issued invoices expose a separate Paid/Unpaid selector. Paid invoices record payment date (today by default, editable) and Bank Transfer or Cash.
Mark Paid opens an in-app dialog with editable payment date and payment method. Existing duplicate-payment checks and invoice-linked Accounting income behavior are retained.
Invoice numbering uses the highest saved invoice/income number and the production reservation key. Numbers are reserved after a successful save; existing numbers are not renumbered.

Legacy invoices missing a valid number are assigned a unique number after existing invoice and income numbers, with linked income references updated only for conclusive invoiceId or generated income IDs.
Records includes invoice rows and retains soft-deleted invoices as Deleted records. Invoice-linked income is managed through the invoice workflow.
The malformed payment-dialog markup was removed from the PDF preview document and placed in the application DOM. All six inline scripts pass JavaScript syntax compilation.

Production LocalStorage namespace remains tha_v206_; IndexedDB schema remains 1. No test namespace, test cleanup, automatic orphan-income deletion, or backup restore is included. Existing accounting and project records are not intentionally cleared or migrated.
